name: URY admin Daily P&L
describe: Daily P&L at 1440x900 inside the admin shell with the Reports group open: branch and date selects, four KPI figures and the P&L Statement waterfall with grouped breakup rows, subtotals and highlighted headline rows; the sample day is a loss day, so Gross and Net Profit show the destructive tint with a minus sign above the fold.

The statement runs below the fold; the main area scrolls. Arabic comes from ury/translations/ar.csv; "Amount", the item, group, branch and breakup names and the sample dates are translated here because ar.csv has no usable entry. "# Orders" and "% of Total" are hard-coded English in the source and stay English. Header cells follow data-table.tsx (12px/500 text-tertiary).
